name: Chained
author: Noblood
description:
Carla is a young aspiring witch but she is an impatient one. Her impatient came back and bit her where it hurts when one reckless experiment sent her and her house flying. After she woke up, she found her soul split in two, one half is still in the land of the living while the other in underworld. She must find a way to reach her former master in her current condition before she ends up in the land of the dead for good.

Chained is a game built in a span of 3 days as part of an Exam with Coding Dojo. The exam had us work in our preference of teams or solo to build a game that meet certain setup requirements. 

This game is made with Unity by Ali and Shahad. It was made for practice and exam purposes. All credits are duo to all the assists used.
